run_squad_training: run BERT training on SQuAD dataset with configurable learning rate, batch size, and epochs
evaluate_squad_model: evaluate a trained BERT question-answering model on SQuAD dev or test set and compute F1 scores
read_squad_examples: read a SQuAD JSON file into a list of SquadExample objects for training or evaluation
convert_examples_to_features: convert SquadExample objects into InputFeatures with tokenized input_ids, masks, and segment_ids
make_predictions: generate answer predictions from model logits using n-best scoring and null-answer thresholding
